items.label: 1904年
items.title: 心导管术先驱福斯曼出生
items.text: 德国外科医生福斯曼出生。他后来切开自己手臂静脉，把导管送入心脏并拍下X光片，这次自我实验为多种心脏检查铺平道路，1956年他与两位同行共享诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。

sources.fact_quote: From the crook of his arm he inserted a thin catheter through a vein into his heart and took an X-ray photo. The experiment paved the way for many types of heart studies.
for their discoveries concerning heart catheterization and pathological changes in the circulatory system

items.label: 1911年
items.title: 雅希人伊希走出荒野
items.text: 当时被认为是雅希部落最后幸存者的伊希在加州奥罗维尔镇外被狗围住，结束了多年隐居。加州大学人类学家把他接到博物馆，用蜡筒录音保存其语言歌谣，成为美国人类学史上珍贵又饱受争议的一页。

sources.date_quote: On August 29, 1911, after the death of his family and other remaining Yahi, Ishi was cornered by dogs outside the town of Oroville, CA.
sources.fact_quote: Holding Ishi in the local jail, town officials reached out to the Hearst Museum, then known as the University of California Museum of Anthropology.

items.label: 1943年
items.title: 中微子物理学家麦克唐纳出生
items.text: 加拿大物理学家麦克唐纳出生。他领导的萨德伯里中微子观测站发现太阳中微子振荡，显示中微子具有质量，为粒子物理带来重要修正，2015年获得诺贝尔物理学奖。

sources.fact_quote: for the discovery of neutrino oscillations, which shows that neutrinos have mass

items.label: 1949年
items.title: 苏联试爆首枚原子弹
items.text: 苏联在哈萨克斯坦塞米巴拉金斯克试验场引爆代号RDS-1的钚原子弹，库尔恰托夫主持的核物理与工程体系由此得到整体验证，冷战进入核军备竞赛新阶段。

sources.date_quote: The successful test of RDS-1, or Little Joe, occurred in a field in modern day Kazakhstan on August 29, 1949.
sources.fact_quote: With the help of information provided by spies in Los Alamos, physicist Igor Kurchatov developed the first Soviet atomic bomb.

items.label: 1965年
items.title: 双子座5号安全返航
items.text: 双子座5号飞船溅落大西洋，两名宇航员完成近8天轨道飞行，创下当时载人航天时长纪录，验证人体能适应长时间失重，为阿波罗登月铺路。

sources.fact_quote: The mission demonstrated human ability to adapt to weightlessness over an extended period and then readapt to normal gravity and was considered successful.

items.label: 1982年
items.title: 合成第109号元素鿏
items.text: 德国重离子研究所用铁-58原子核轰击铋-209靶，合成并确认了第109号元素。这一元素以物理学家莉泽·迈特纳命名，中文名为鿏，它极不稳定，是超重元素合成研究的重要里程碑。

sources.date_quote: On August 29, 1982, physicists at the Heavy Ion Research Laboratory, Darmstadt, West Germany made and identified element 109 by bombing a target of 209Bi with accelerated nuclei of 58Fe.
sources.fact_quote: This experiment demonstrated the feasibility of using fusion techniques as a method of making new, heavy nuclei.

items.label: 2018年
items.title: 经济学家莫里斯去世
items.text: 英国经济学家莫里斯在剑桥去世。他研究信息不对称下的激励机制，阐明税收与契约设计如何在信息不透明时仍能兼顾效率，与维克里分享1996年诺贝尔经济学奖。

sources.fact_quote: for their fundamental contributions to the economic theory of incentives under asymmetric information
